Class ProcessorOptionsSystemProperties

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.visitor.util.ProcessorOptionsSystemProperties
@Internal public final class ProcessorOptionsSystemProperties extends Object
Exposes the Micronaut processor options of a compilation as system properties, for the visitors that read them from there (in particular micronaut-openapi), and restores the previous values once the compilation is over.

The properties are applied when a processor is initialized, and restored when the last processor that acquired them releases them at the end of processing. Without that, in a long-lived JVM (a Gradle daemon, a test suite, an IDE) the options of one compilation would be seen by every later compilation.

A processor that is initialized but never asked to process anything never acquires the properties, so it does not hold them. When a compilation applies its options while nothing holds the properties of a previous compilation, those are restored first.

Since:
5.2.16
Author:
Denis Stepanov
